purpose: Inventory of the engine wire boundary a future Rust/WASM engine must preserve. Prepared in #519; no Rust code and no adapter rewrite.
invariants: Commands and results keep their discriminant spellings, error codes and absent-versus-null fields.
The ruleset version selects historical behavior; an old journal replays unchanged.
State and projections keep stable ids, array order and secret visibility.
Randomness, time and ids enter through recorded command-port outputs, not platform sources.
One mutation path, preview isolation, atomic rollback and idempotency stay in the adapter.

conformancePilot.reason: A committed legacy v4 save, not a TypeScript constructor, drives the pilot: one deterministic setNotes command asserted on the real engine result and state.
